method: Hidden property profiles for every rune, computed from language (Brent 2026-10-22).

heat.plus: hot heat burn fire warm scorch blaze
heat.minus: cold freeze ice chill frost cool frozen

motion.plus: move fast rush flow swift speed race
motion.minus: still stop rest halt stillness static motionless

force.plus: push strike crush blast force slam smash
force.minus: gentle soft delicate weak ease light tender

form.plus: build solid structure harden shape forge form
form.minus: break shatter dissolve crumble decay melt scatter

vitality.plus: life heal grow alive birth vigor living
vitality.minus: death kill die rot corpse dead perish

light.plus: light bright shine glow reveal visible radiant
light.minus: dark shadow hide conceal obscure gloom darkness

mind.plus: mind thought dream imagine perceive feel memory
mind.minus: body flesh matter physical material muscle bone

extent.plus: spread wide expand everywhere vast widespread broad
extent.minus: focus narrow point single concentrate small precise

duration.plus: linger last persist endure lasting long remain
duration.minus: instant sudden brief quick flash momentary abrupt

binding.plus: bind hold join grip attach tie fasten
binding.minus: release sever free loosen detach cut separate

direction.plus: outward emit release expel radiate push spill
direction.minus: inward absorb draw pull suck take gather

runes.name: Flood
runes.meaning: fill an area with water; the ground turns Wet

runes.name: Drain
runes.meaning: empty the water from an area or a target, and draw it in

runes.name: Dry
runes.meaning: pull the water out of a body: damage by how wet it is

runes.name: Heave
runes.meaning: lift a body bodily and throw it

runes.name: Drown
runes.meaning: water in the lungs: no casting, no calls for help, damage over time

runes.name: Settle
runes.meaning: the water goes still, and what it carries sinks and stays

runes.name: Splash
runes.meaning: burst outward on contact, spraying those near

runes.name: Seep
runes.meaning: soak in slowly, getting behind shields and armour

runes.name: Wave
runes.meaning: a rolling wall of water that carries what it meets

runes.name: Quench
runes.meaning: put fire out, and cash the heat in

runes.name: Ignite
runes.meaning: start a fire at a point

runes.name: Snuff
runes.meaning: put out one flame or source at once

runes.name: Smother
runes.meaning: starve a fire, or a foe, of air

runes.name: Catch
runes.meaning: fire leaps from a burning body to every body near it

runes.name: Sear
runes.meaning: drive all the heat into one point: white-hot

runes.name: Dig
runes.meaning: tear into the ground and bring stone up to throw

runes.name: Collapse
runes.meaning: bring the ground down and close a passage

runes.name: Weigh
runes.meaning: add mass: grow so heavy that nothing moves you and everything near leans toward you

runes.name: Buoy
runes.meaning: lighten: lift a thing out of the ground to throw it

runes.name: Deflect
runes.meaning: turn a blow or a rush aside, and the one behind it with it

runes.name: Strike
runes.meaning: a bolt that hits one target

runes.name: Ground
runes.meaning: earth a charge away; draw strikes to a point

runes.name: Insulate
runes.meaning: block a jump, isolate a target

runes.name: Silence
runes.meaning: dead quiet: casting and calls fail

runes.name: Frost
runes.meaning: creeping cold on the ground that grips and slows

runes.name: Snow
runes.meaning: a fall of snow that blinds and buries

runes.name: Melt
runes.meaning: turn ice and snow to water

runes.name: Floe
runes.meaning: drifting ice carried by the current

runes.name: Expose
runes.meaning: make a hidden target stand out

runes.name: Pin
runes.meaning: nail a target's shadow, and the target with it

runes.name: Resound
runes.meaning: a sound thrown into the dark that draws every ear

runes.name: Fuse
runes.meaning: weld two into one piece: a foe chained to you, or two foes together

runes.name: Breach
runes.meaning: break a seal; punch through plate

runes.name: Dull
runes.meaning: blunt edges, theirs included: take a blow on your blade and turn it dull

runes.name: Spill
runes.meaning: give it out, as a weapon or a gift

runes.name: Clot
runes.meaning: blood hardens: armour, blades, a stopped wound

runes.name: Pulse
runes.meaning: the heart pounds - your own, in frenzy

runes.name: Thirst
runes.meaning: hunger for blood: the drive that reaches for it

runes.name: Sate
runes.meaning: drink a body to the dregs: finish it and take all its blood

runes.name: Cure
runes.meaning: end an affliction of the body: a sickness, a poison, a burn or a bleed

runes.name: Regrow
runes.meaning: restore what was lost, limbs included

runes.name: Tithe
runes.meaning: take life from a living body into yours

runes.name: Bestow
runes.meaning: give life outward into a body: your summons, or a small body of your own

runes.name: Spare
runes.meaning: hold a life at the edge, for capture or mercy

runes.name: Preserve
runes.meaning: stop decay: in the dead you keep, and in your own body

runes.name: Haunt
runes.meaning: what dies lingers as a spirit

runes.name: Vanish
runes.meaning: pass out of sight and reach

runes.name: Bid
runes.meaning: the dead do your bidding: send them, and they go

runes.name: Unbind
runes.meaning: let your dead go, and what held them goes outward

runes.name: Grow
runes.meaning: make a thing larger and stronger - a plant, a beast, or you

runes.name: Flourish
runes.meaning: thrive: strengthen what grows, and what lives in it

runes.name: Harvest
runes.meaning: take what has grown, and its yield

runes.name: Herd
runes.meaning: gather beasts to you - called up out of the growth - and drive them onto your quarry

runes.name: Unleash
runes.meaning: let the bound go wild: a pack off its leash

runes.name: Bend
runes.meaning: bend light through a lens to a burning point

runes.name: Ray
runes.meaning: all the light in one line

runes.name: Prism
runes.meaning: split the light into many rays

runes.name: Wake
runes.meaning: rouse; break a trance - your own mind included

runes.name: Charm
runes.meaning: win a mind over: for a while it is yours

runes.name: Doubt
runes.meaning: plant doubt: nothing is done with conviction

runes.name: Envenom
runes.meaning: coat a blade or a shot so what it strikes is dosed

runes.name: Contaminate
runes.meaning: foul an area or a thing

runes.name: Corrode
runes.meaning: acid that eats armour and metal

runes.name: Neutralise
runes.meaning: render a poison or acid harmless

runes.name: Steep
runes.meaning: let a poison soak in slowly, so it does more when it comes due

runes.name: Lance
runes.meaning: open and drain a festering wound

runes.name: Inter
runes.meaning: bury the sick under sick earth, which goes on breathing it out

runes.name: Exhume
runes.meaning: dig up the buried, and the grave-rot with it

runes.name: Ward
runes.meaning: raise a guard of light over a body that is yours

runes.name: Humble
runes.meaning: bring a guard down: shields, armour and the boons on a foe

runes.name: Bless
runes.meaning: give a boon to a body that is yours

runes.name: Absolve
runes.meaning: lift a burden from a body: holds, slows, fear, blindness

runes.name: Penance
runes.meaning: lay a burden on a foe that it pays for itself

runes.name: Hallow
runes.meaning: make a place holy, and keep what is yours in it

runes.name: Exile
runes.meaning: drive a foe out and keep it out

runes.name: Mercy
runes.meaning: soften harm and give it back as healing

runes.name: Patience
runes.meaning: wait for the blow, and answer it

runes.name: Leech
runes.meaning: draw the life out of what you strike, into yourself

runes.name: Outpour
runes.meaning: let out what you took, as harm

runes.name: Daunt
runes.meaning: fear that drives them back from you

runes.name: Beckon
runes.meaning: the dark calls them in, and does not let them go

runes.name: Gloom
runes.meaning: darkness that hangs about you and goes where you go

runes.name: Shroud
runes.meaning: darkness drawn tight onto your own body

runes.name: Reave
runes.meaning: tear out the last of a failing life and keep it

runes.name: Stalk
runes.meaning: come at your prey through the dark and do not let it go

runes.name: Forsake
runes.meaning: break away, and leave dread on the ground behind you

runes.name: Motion
runes.meaning: it travels, or moves what it touches

runes.name: Stillness
runes.meaning: it is held in place; what it touches is held

runes.name: Straight
runes.meaning: a true line that cannot be turned aside

runes.name: Focus
runes.meaning: concentrated on a point or an edge

runes.name: One
runes.meaning: a single target takes all of it

runes.name: Elsewhere
runes.meaning: displaced: it lands, or moves you, somewhere else

runes.name: Fade
runes.meaning: short, ends early, stronger while it lasts

runes.name: Once
runes.meaning: one time, all of it at once

runes.name: Before
runes.meaning: acts on what was: undo, rewind

runes.name: After
runes.meaning: acts on what comes: foresight, the next hit

runes.name: Take
runes.meaning: takes from the target, to you
